info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tetrahed Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of detailed specifications for the Tetrahed Recliner product within the catalog. It allows businesses to create and update information related to the Tetrahed Recliner, ensuring accurate and up-to-date listings. Typical use cases include inventory management systems and online retail platforms that require detailed product descriptions. The API engages developers and product managers looking to enhance their product catalog efficiently.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for the Tetrahed Recliner. It is designed to help users submit important specifications and attributes for this unique product.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the details for a new tetrahed recliner. It requires specific parameters to accurately reflect the desired configuration of the recliner. Ensure all required fields are populated to avoid validation errors.

200.description: The request was successful, and the details are returned.
